organization_logic.macro_structure: 20 prose pages + 4-page appendix (MATLAB code + AHP matrices). Two-model pipeline: Model 1 (network, 5 pages) -> Model 2 (evaluation, 4 pages) -> Correlation (1 page) -> Sensitivity (2 pages) -> Suggestions (3 pages) -> Generalization (3 pages) -> Strengths/Weaknesses (2 pages).
organization_logic.dominant_pattern: Linear pipeline: network characterization -> composite index -> statistical validation -> coaching recommendations -> domain extension
organization_logic.section_coupling: Strong sequential coupling: Model 1 feeds R1 to Model 2; AHP feeds R2 to Model 2. Generalization section weakly coupled (analogical, no data).
organization_logic.argument_quality: Solid data-driven pipeline through sensitivity analysis. Weakened by correlation-causation conflation and unsupported generalization.
human_organization_signals: In-this-way repeated 7+ times as section closure
Author-by-author literature chain rather than thematic grouping
Numbered assumptions with named labels (Particle, Two-dimensional, etc.)
Four formation recommendations as sequential advice

global_organization_chain: Context (soccer + data era) -> Problem (quantify teamwork via models)

Evaluation (6 factors + EWM + TAI) -> Validation (SPSS correlation 0.024)
Application (formation + player + squad recommendations) -> Sensitivity (CI stability)

main_argument_chains.claim: Soccer team structure can be decomposed into macro (formation), micro (tactics), and middle (style) levels using passing network analysis.
support_steps: construct passing network from event data
screen four tactics via coordinate inequalities
classify four styles via 15-min possession-position windows
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Without multi-level decomposition, the paper would only capture aggregate statistics and miss the granular tactical patterns that distinguish winning from losing games.

main_argument_chains.claim: Team performance is best quantified by a composite index (TAI) of six attributional factors weighted by entropy method.
support_steps: define six factors covering attack efficiency, coordination, tactics, ability, adaptability, flexibility
apply min-max standardization and EWM weighting
compute TAI as weighted linear combination
validate via SPSS correlation with GD (significance 0.024)
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Without objective EWM weighting, the composite index would rely on subjective expert judgment and lack statistical validation.

main_argument_chains.claim: Coaching decisions should adapt formation and lineup based on opponent and player abilities.
support_steps: rank player abilities via position-specific AHP
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Without data-driven recommendations, the coach would rely on intuition rather than systematic analysis of formation-opponent interactions.
